notes: Background: 5k engineers, mono-repo + internal packages. Want single index for code + docs but separate rerank stage.
Primary ask: reliable code search with reranking using embeddings + light contextual LLM rerank. Replace brittle grep-based tooling.
Quote from VP Eng: 'We need sub-200ms tail latency for dev-facing queries or the devs will reject it'
Frequent re-indexing: nightly full repo index + delta updates every 10-15 minutes during business hours.
Data residency: EU customer code must stay in eu-1 region; sensitive repos flagged for on-prem air-gapped processing.
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.001 / query at 90th pct for combined vector + rerank step. Heavy query mix during working hours (9-18 UTC).
Model preference: open models that can be quantized and run on dedicated pods; fallback to hosted smaller models for non-sensitive data.
POC scope: 100M-200M embeddings, 10-20M queries/month simulated, mixed short code-snippet and natural language queries.
Security: SSO via SAML 2.0 (Okta), KMS for key material, audit trails per token, 1yr retention default with option to shorten.
Eng notes: prefer sticky routing to dedicated pool for high-qps routes; need batch sizing control and prefix caching for common search prefixes.
Sales notes: procurement expects legal + infosec loop to finish before pilot expands. Price sensitivity around reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go.
Drive links: poc-plan-v2.pdf (ingest topology, perf targets), hawthorn-security-answers.xlsx (security Q&A)
requirements_summary: Scale: target index size 100M-1B embeddings; initial POC 100M
Reindex cadence: full nightly rebuild + delta updates every 10-15 minutes
Latency targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms, p99 < 450ms for vector+rerank end-to-end (developer interactive)
Throughput: sustained 1k qps peak across routes, burst to 3k qps for release windows
Cost: target blended cost-per-query < $0.001; want cost vs latency tradeoff dashboard
Reranking: two-stage pipeline (dense retrieval -> lightweight LLM rerank), rerank tokens budgeted per-query
Model constraints: ability to pin quantized open models on dedicated GPU nodes, automatic fallback to smaller variants
Data controls: SSO/SAML, per-request audit logging, KMS integration for keys, EU residency for flagged repos
Operational: tracing for token-level cost attribution, automatic eviction of stale vectors, hooks for downstream CI
tech_stack: On prem: Kubernetes 1.27, internal object store (S3-compatible)
Storage: mix of S3 and local NVMe on GPU nodes
